content.lb_assessment: The recent XGBoost run with extensive target encoding only marginally improved CV (0.94267 vs 0.94239) and remains well below the best public score (0.94558). LightGBM runs with larger num_leaves have CV around 0.94, also insufficient. Since the gap to the top‑20% threshold is tiny (0.00082), the most promising lever is adding external data, which historically yields larger lifts than further tuning.
